_comment: Maps registry audit_status values to the agent's lifecycle action. Matching is case-insensitive. Statuses not listed fall back to prefix rules (HOLD* -> ESCALATE, PENDING* -> FOLLOW_UP, CLEARED -> COMMIT) and finally to ESCALATE.

degree_conferred.note: Registry confirms the degree has been conferred

requirement_waived.note: Registry records an approved requirement waiver; record finalised with the waiver noted

conferral_pending.task: Confirm degree conferral with the Office of the Registrar, then update audit_status

grade_appeal_pending.task: Await grade appeal outcome, then re-verify GPA and conferral date

academic_hold.note: Academic hold on the student record

record_sealed.note: Record is sealed; automated processing is not permitted - route to the records custodian
